rows.grounds: compound of sarva (all), alaṅkāra (ornament), and saṃyukta (joined/endowed); qualifies the betel offering mentioned in the preceding context
compound of mātaṅka (elephant) and upari (upon/above), indicating location
past participle describing the positioned state of the offering

items.question: In what adorned condition and upon what support must the betel offering be presented?
premises: The betel offering is endowed with all ornaments.
The betel offering is situated upon an elephant.
These attributes specify the required presentation of the offering.
items.inference: The betel offering must be presented fully adorned and placed upon an elephant.
uncertainties: The exact referent is inferred from the preceding verse's mention of tāmbūlaṃ.
items.plain_english: It should be endowed with all ornaments and situated upon an elephant.
